d: Unscripted laughs, surprising confessions, and unforgettable personal stories of adventure travel and ancient history straight from Hollywood's biggest names. Join host Josh Gates as he sits down for candid conversations with celebrity guests, explorers, and entertainers who open up like never before. From behind-the-scenes mishaps in mysterious places on Earth and encounters with ancient ruins to personal tales inspired by lost civilisations and famous historical figures, every chat blends sharp humour with genuine curiosity. Grab a drink and enjoy the best guest moments packed with wit,…
